verdict.rationale: Missive supports rules-based automation directly ("Automate your workflows," up to 1000 rules) plus event-driven triggers via webhooks, REST API, and MCP-connected AI agents that act on conversations/contacts/calendar automatically. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation detailing the rule-builder's trigger/condition/action UI or a full list of supported trigger events, and no independent/hands-on verification of rules actually firing reliably.
